description: This file defines the 'Loop' class, which implements a loop construct within a mini-language used in the OFBiz framework. It processes an XML element representing a loop with a specified count and a variable field, executing nested operations multiple times as per the count.

classes.name: Loop
classes.description: Implements a loop operation for the mini-language, executing nested operations a specified number of times based on an attribute 'count'. It handles validation, execution, and control flow exceptions like break and continue.

methods.name: exec
methods.description: Executes the loop by expanding the 'count' expression, converting it to an integer, and running nested operations for that many iterations, handling break and continue exceptions appropriately.

methods.name: gatherArtifactInfo
methods.description: Collects artifact information from nested operations.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the Loop object, including its 'count' and 'field' attributes.
